mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN ( SELECT STAY_ID, MIN(PRICE) AS MIN_PRICE, COUNT(*) AS ROOM_CNT FROM ROOM GROUP BY STAY_ID ) R ON S.ID = R.STAY_ID
( SELECT F.URL FROM FILES F WHERE F.REF_TYPE = 'STAY' AND F.REF_ID = S.ID AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS THUMB
mapper.select:
SELECT S.ID AS STAY_ID, S.NAME, S.ADDR1, S.ADDR2, S.LAT, S.LNG, S.TAGS, NVL(R.MIN_PRICE, 0) AS minPrice, NVL(R.ROOM_CNT, 0) AS roomCount,
FROM STAY S
AND S.REGION = #{region}
AND S.TAGS LIKE '%' || #{tag} || '%'
AND NVL(R.MIN_PRICE, 0) <= #{maxPrice}
ORDER BY NVL(R.MIN_PRICE, 999999999) ASC
ORDER BY S.ID
SELECT ID, STAY_ID, NAME, PRICE, MAXPEOPLE, MAXPET, FROM ROOM WHERE STAY_ID = #{stayId} ORDER BY PRICE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO STAY ( BIZ_ID, NAME, PHONE, ZIPCODE, ADDR1, ADDR2, REGION, CREATED ) SELECT B.ID, B.NAME, B.PHONE, B.ZIPCODE, B.ADDR1, B.ADDR2, CASE WHEN B.ADDR1 LIKE '%서울%' THEN '서울' WHEN B.ADDR1 LIKE '%경기%' THEN '경기' WHEN B.ADDR1 LIKE '%인천%' THEN '인천' WHEN B.ADDR1 LIKE '%강원%' THEN '강원' WHEN B.ADDR1 LIKE '%제주%' THEN '제주' WHEN B.ADDR1 LIKE '%부산%' THEN '부산' WHEN B.ADDR1 LIKE '%대구%' THEN '대구' WHEN B.ADDR1 LIKE '%울산%' THEN '울산' WHEN B.ADDR1 LIKE '%광주%' THEN '광주' WHEN B.ADDR1 LIKE '%대전%' THEN '대전' WHEN B.ADDR1 LIKE '%세종%' THEN '세종' WHEN B.ADDR1 LIKE '%경상%' OR B.ADDR1 LIKE '%경북%' OR B.ADDR1 LIKE '%경남%' THEN '경상' WHEN B.ADDR1 LIKE '%전라%' OR B.ADDR1 LIKE '%전북%' OR B.ADDR1 LIKE '%전남%' THEN '전라' WHEN B.ADDR1 LIKE '%충청%' OR B.ADDR1 LIKE '%충북%' OR B.ADDR1 LIKE '%충남%' THEN '충청' ELSE '기타' END, SYSDATE FROM BUSINESS B WHERE B.ID = #{bizId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM STAY S WHERE S.BIZ_ID = B.ID )
mapper.select: SELECT ID AS ROOM_ID, STAY_ID, NAME, PRICE, MAXPEOPLE, MAXPET, CREATED FROM ROOM WHERE STAY_ID = #{stayId} ORDER BY STAY_ID

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ROOM ( STAY_ID, NAME, PRICE, MAXPEOPLE, MAXPET, CREATED ) VALUES ( #{stayId}, #{name}, #{price}, #{maxPeople, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{maxPet, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SYSDATE )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ROOM WHERE ID = #{roomId} AND STAY_ID = #{stayId}
